name: WebVoyager
summary: Multimodal end-to-end web agent research code and 643-task dataset across 15 real websites, with GPT-4V auto-eval protocol.
description: Established 2024 research release (MinorJerry/WebVoyager; Apache-2.0; not archived; last push observed 2024-03), not a newly launched product. Selenium-based online browsing; dataset data/WebVoyager_data.jsonl (~643 tasks). Some Booking/Google Flights tasks are time-sensitive and need manual date updates per README. Running against live sites can trigger real-world side effects (bookings, forms); use carefully. Model APIs and browser/OS dependencies are separate.

agent_access.notes: Public repository; local conda/pip setup with Chrome/Chromium. Live-site runs can have real-world side effects.
